output_path.description: Path to final translation output (null when cancelled/failed)

alignment_path.description: Path to bilingual alignment data (null when cancelled/failed)

glossary_path.description: Path to glossary used (null when cancelled/failed)

qa_report_path.description: Path to quality report (null when cancelled/failed)

status.description: Execution outcome. success: translation completed, all artifact paths must be absolute. cancelled: aborted before translation (e.g. source and target are the same language), artifact paths must be null. failed: unrecoverable error, artifact paths must be null.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. For success: brief summary of completed work (free-form). For cancelled: why the task was aborted. For failed: error description including root cause.

provenance.description: Translation run metadata: source/target language identification, input provenance, and work statistics. Populated regardless of status; statistics fields (total_blocks etc.) may be omitted for non-success statuses.

source_path.description: The original source_path input value, preserved verbatim.

source_language.description: Detected source language in BCP-47 format (e.g. en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP). Must match Phase 2 analysis output.

target_language.description: Target language in BCP-47 format (e.g. zh-CN, en, ja). Must match the resolved target_language parameter.

total_blocks.description: Total number of blocks produced by blockify phase (Phase 4). Omit when status is not success.

total_sentences.description: Total number of sentences produced by sentencify/build_block_sentences phase (Phase 5). Omit when status is not success.

total_batches.description: Total number of translation batches produced by partition phase (Phase 6). Omit when status is not success.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues collected during execution (e.g. risky sentence pairs, partial retry exhaustion, missing block translations). Empty array when none. Present regardless of status.
